items.title: Uganda: Uganda, Somalia Agree to Intensify Military Offensive Against Al-Shabaab
items.description: [Independent (Kampala)] Kampala -- Uganda and Somalia have agreed to intensify military operations against Al-Shabaab militants and explore alternative funding mechanisms to sustain security operations in Somalia. The agreement was reached during a meeting between President Yoweri Museveni and his Somali counterpart, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, who was on a one-day official visit to Uganda on November 23, 2026.
items.titleIt: Uganda: Uganda, Somalia Agree to Intensify Military Offensive Against Al-Shabaab

items.title: Somalia: An Italian-Funded Master’s Program Launches

items.title: Investigation underway into cause of Zanzibar hotel blaze
items.description: Investigations continued Monday into the cause of a huge fire that engulfed six hotels along a popular beach in Tanzania ’s semiautonomous archipelago of Zanzibar. Several hotel workers were injured in the blaze over the weekend. Authorities said about 180 tourists were safely evacuated.
items.titleIt: Investigation underway into cause of Zanzibar hotel blaze

items.title: Ethiopia: Ethiopia, Pakistan Agree to Deepen Defence and Aviation Cooperation
items.description: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia and Pakistan have agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation in defence and aviation, opening further avenues for strategic partnership between the two countries.
items.titleIt: Ethiopia: Ethiopia, Pakistan Agree to Deepen Defence and Aviation Cooperation

items.title: East Africa: Somalia's Parliament Speaker Accuses Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda of Colluding With Al-Shabaab
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Somalia's parliamentary speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, also known as Jaamac, has accused Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda of colluding with Al-Shabaab, alleging that Israel had brought together the three countries, the militant group and forces loyal to former South West State leader Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen in a coordinated front against the federal government.
items.titleIt: East Africa: Somalia's Parliament Speaker Accuses Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda of Colluding With Al-Shabaab

items.title: Sudan: Violations Against Women, Girls Escalates
items.description: [Dabanga] Blue Nile State -- The Strategic Initiative for Women in the Horn of Africa (SIHA Network) has reported the abduction of 28 women and girls fleeing fighting in Damazin and 15 cases of conflict-related sexual violence against girls under the age of 18 in Blue Nile state. In a statement published yesterday, the organisation has warned of escalating violations against women and girls as fighting intensifies, with thousands of families fleeing their homes and facing growing humanitarian risks.
items.titleIt: Sudan: Violations Against Women, Girls Escalates

items.title: Calabria Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 in Belgrade
items.description: (ANSA) - BELGRADO, 24 NOV - The Commissioner of the Italian Pavilion at Expo 2027 Belgrade, Ambassador to Serbia Luca Gori, and the President of the Calabria Region, Roberto Occhiuto, signed the agreement outlining the terms of the Region’s participation in the International Specialized Exposition, scheduled to take place in the Serbian capital from May 15 to August 15, 2027. Expo 2027 Belgrade, titled “Playing for Humanity: Sports and Music for All,” will feature the participation of approximately 140 countries. The signed agreement implements the Framework Agreement initialed on June 24, 202
items.titleIt: Calabria Signs Agreement to Participate in Expo 2027 in Belgrade
